bull.b: Strong ARR growth combined with expanding RPO and contracted billings provides durable revenue visibility. This supports continued scale over the next several quarters and reduces reliance on entirely new bookings for near-term growth.

High retention, customer expansion, and broader multi-product adoption indicate that Netskope is embedding its platform more deeply within enterprise environments. This can support recurring growth and improve lifetime customer economics.

bull.t: Improving gross margin and cash-flow direction
bull.b: Higher gross margin demonstrates improving unit economics as revenue scales, while the expected return to positive full-year free cash flow signals progress toward a more self-funding model. Sustained delivery would strengthen financial flexibility.

bear.b: The company’s operating expense base remains disproportionate to gross profit, producing very large losses despite rapid revenue growth. Until expense leverage improves materially, profitability and cash conversion remain exposed to execution or growth slowdowns.

bear.t: Elevated leverage and risky capital structure
bear.b: High debt relative to equity limits financial flexibility and increases pressure to sustain growth and improve margins. Although equity turned positive in 2026, the balance sheet remains vulnerable while losses and returns to shareholders are weak.

bear.t: Sales execution and AI monetization uncertainty
bear.b: Soft net new ARR and a heavily ramping salesforce create execution risk for the expected second-half acceleration. AI products add growth potential, but early-stage budgets and pilot activity make the timing and scale of monetization uncertain.
